titulo: Three ways to wait for a friend
caption:
Three ways to wait for a friend

I used to wait for friends with my face in my phone. Then I started just being there when they arrived.

When someone arrives, the first few seconds of how they are met set the tone for the rest of the visit.

For whoever is calm while someone is late.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table and an orange mug on it, and a royal blue figure that walks in from the right, late, in each of three labeled scenes. The scroller: a teal figure looks down at a buzzing phone and the blue one says sorry, late! The sigher: a brown figure narrows its eyes and trembles, and says finally. The one who stays: an ink-black figure with happy eyes sits by a steaming mug and says no rush. The text stays: three kinds of waiting. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
